name: crosshost-review-collect
title: M1: auto-collect an independent second-host review verdict and surface disagreements
description: Build the missing orchestration that turns the manual 2-host quorum into an automatic cross-host adversarial review. Scope: (1) an orchestrating command that runs Codex as an INDEPENDENT REVIEWER over the same materialHash-bound change and captures a STRUCTURED verdict (decision plus findings), parsing only structured fields; (2) feed that verdict into the existing submitLocalVerdict / autopilot_review_submit path so it binds to the exact code; (3) a joint-decision step that compares host-A and host-B verdicts and explicitly surfaces disagreements. Reuse dispatch_prepare, the bounded Codex spawn primitive, and the verdict-capture endpoint; extend checkDispatchPolicy to sanction a bounded Codex real-leaf for REVIEW only. OUT OF SCOPE: cryptographic signing / pinned-key receipts (deferred as external-skeptic-only), any Authority-server path (deleted), and the work-signal dispatch verdict field. Repro-first: a RED test asserting no command today produces a structured materialHash-bound host-B review verdict plus a disagreement report; a SPIKE proving Codex can emit a parseable structured verdict that the joint-decision step diffs.
